CORE PLATFORM
🌍 African Food DatabaseFoods, composition, recipes, portions, local dietary patterns and food ontology.

🚨 Early WarningFood, climate, nutrition, NCD and supply-risk signals with human review.
🔗 InteroperabilityAPIs, standardized indicators and connectors for national and institutional systems.
🔐 Privacy & GovernanceConsent, data minimization, access control, auditability, safeguarding and provenance.
